source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of applications of industrial chemistry (PDF 243).

items: Petrochemical sanat: kache tel se plastics, masnoi rubber aur reshe banati hai. Kacha tel crack (tor) kar chhote molecules banaye jate hain, jo lubricants, waxes aur masnoi rubber ki bunyaad bante hain.

Cosmetics ki sanat: make-up, sabun aur khushbuon ke ajza banati hai. Yeh surfactants (sabun ke liye), emulsifiers (creams ko hamwar rakhne ke liye) aur preservatives (bacteria ki barhotri rokne ke liye) use karti hai; chemistry yaqeeni banati hai ke yeh products insani jild ke liye pH-mutawazin hon.

Cement ki sanat: chuna-pathar aur matti (clay) se aik ahem tameeri maddah banati hai. Chuna-pathar aur clay ka achhi tarah mila amezah rotary kiln mein taqreeban 1500 C tak garam kiya jata hai, aur hasil shuda maddah gypsum ke saath pees kar cement banta hai.

Khurak ki sanat: ghizai additives, preservatives aur khurak ki processing ke kimiyai maddey banati hai. Sodium benzoate preservative ke taur par aam hai; hydrogenation khane ke tel ko margarine jaisi thos charbi mein badalti hai; baking mein sodium bicarbonate (baking soda) jaise leavening agents use hote hain; aur namak mein iodine ya tel mein vitamin A mila kar khurak ko fortify kiya jata hai.

blocks.alt: Chaar khane teeron se jure: limestone + clay -> rotary kiln (about 1500 degree C) -> ground with gypsum -> cement.

blocks.title: Kya aap jante hain?
blocks.text: Pani milane par cement garam kyun hota hai? Cement pani se exothermic hydration reaction karta aur hararat chhorta hai, isi liye taza mila cement garam ho jata hai.
